code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=grid[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
                while stack:
                    x,y=stack.pop(); comp.append((x,y,col))
                    for q in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
                        a,b=q
                        if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and grid[a][b]==col and q not in seen: seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
                comps.append(comp)
    # move objects rightward, processing those furthest right first
    comps.sort(key=lambda z:max(c for r,c,v in z), reverse=True)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for comp in comps:
        d=0
        while True:
            nd=d+1
            if any(c+nd>=w or out[r][c+nd] for r,c,v in comp): break
            d=nd
        for r,c,v in comp: out[r][c+d]=v
    return out
'''
